definitions.explanation: The act of leaving something or someone out from a group, category, or scope. Commonly used in formal, administrative, and legal contexts.

examples.japanese: この{項目|こうもく}は{対象|たいしょう}から{除外|じょがい}する。
examples.english: This item will be excluded from the scope.

examples.japanese: {未成年者|みせいねんしゃ}は{除外|じょがい}されている。
{特別|とくべつ}な{事情|じじょう}がある{場合|ばあい}は、{適用|てきよう}{除外|じょがい}となることがある。
examples.english: In cases with special circumstances, an exemption from application may be granted.

notes:
USAGE:
{除外|じょがい} is used as both a noun and a suru-verb. It carries a formal tone and is common in rules, regulations, and official documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対象|たいしょう}から{除外|じょがい}する (to exclude from the scope)
- {適用|てきよう}{除外|じょがい} (exemption from application)
- {除外|じょがい}{条件|じょうけん} (exclusion criteria)
- {除外|じょがい}{対象|たいしょう} (subject of exclusion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{排除|はいじょ} means to eliminate or remove and implies more active rejection or getting rid of something, while {除外|じょがい} is more neutral and simply means to leave out or not include.
